AnimTestUpload.description:
CA0: a turn on the spot rendered by the client from the version's body (the Stage's own pose renderer) — PNG frames put through
`PUT /blobs/{sha}`, in order, with their COCO-18 keypoints.
AnimTestUpload.title: AnimTestUpload

AnimateChain.description:
D111 (PS5c, E23a's W1): a pose-driven performance in batches — this batch starts where the previous one ended. The previous batch's
last `carry` frames continue the motion (`continue_motion`), and the pose guide is read from `offset` on (`video_frame_offset`).
AnimateChain.title: AnimateChain

AudioLayer.description:
D118 (AE4b): a spoken line as an audio layer of the composition, bound to the character's layer; its timing (in, out, start) lives on
the layer itself, placed on the lanes like a picture layer. `file` is the WAV copied under the final's folder (the project moves as one).
AudioLayer.title: AudioLayer

AudioRef.description: D88 XL (experimental): the spoken line a lip-sync clip follows (an `audio` asset, CN2).
AudioRef.title: AudioRef

Beat.description: LTX keyframe guide (11 §3b): the asset is encoded as a guide at `frame` with `strength`.
Beat.title: Beat

BindingOut.description:
D93 (A3): a subject card linked to a profile and the reference images its mention gave (1-based, as the prompt numbers them). D93 (C6):
`role` subject, held (a prop the subject card `subject` holds) or scene (the place of the scene; `subject` None).
BindingOut.title: BindingOut

Body.description:
CA0 (D94, 01 §9 answer 3): the body on the Cast sheet — it shapes the figure's Stage dummy when the figure is bound to this version.
Height in metres; the proportions are factors of the default dummy (1 = the 1.75 m adult); the build widens or narrows it.
Body.title: Body

BodyAttachment.description:
CA0 (01 §9b N1): a rigid part that follows a joint of the figure — a tail, horns, folded wings. Shown on the Stage dummy and in its
clay and depth passes; not in the pose pass (Wan Animate guesses its motion from the reference).
BodyAttachment.title: BodyAttachment

CompositionLayer.description: The lineage: a final layer and what it became in the composition.
CompositionLayer.title: CompositionLayer

ContentAwareCaps.description: D62: whether the native extension (PhotoCraft's content-aware fill + PatchMatch) is installed, and the modes it enables.
ContentAwareCaps.title: ContentAwareCaps

CoverageCaps.description: The coverage vocabulary, and (D115) the phrases a cell puts in the prompt — T8: the page shows what the server composes.
CoverageCaps.title: CoverageCaps

DocShift.description: How far an outpaint grew the canvas to the left and top (the editor moves its layers by it).
DocShift.title: DocShift

DocumentChanged.description: Every variant carries `id`; AI results add `job_id`, `batch_id`, `added`, `group`, …; AI Select adds `selection`.
DocumentChanged.title: DocumentChanged

DocumentPreview.description:
`POST /recipes/preview` for an Edit recipe (inpaint, i2i, upscale, segment — D64): the settings that shape the run, what it needs,
the weights, ETA and VRAM fit, and the contract problems a submission would hit. The region is read at run time, not here.
DocumentPreview.title: DocumentPreview

DocumentPutReply.description: The stack as stored plus the layers / masks the server has no bytes for (B15).
DocumentPutReply.title: DocumentPutReply

EffectCraftSettings.description:
AE1 (proto01_animate 20 §2, D114): the animation editor's engine — the pinned `effectcraft-cli` (engine/effectcraft.pin.json, built by
scripts/build_effectcraft.py into engine/tools/, never in git) driven as one MCP session beside the orchestrator (loom2/effectcraft.py).
A `.py` runs under the orchestrator's interpreter (the tests' fake).
EffectCraftSettings.title: EffectCraftSettings

Expanded.description: 17 §3b: the jobs an Expand queued — one per cell, one batch — and the candidates page they land on.
Expanded.title: Expanded

ExperimentalCaps.description: D88: features shipped before their bars are met — each with the caveat the UI shows beside its verb.
ExperimentalCaps.title: ExperimentalCaps

ExperimentalMouthModelCaps.description: D118 (AE4d): the lip-sync model as a tool — whether LatentSync can redraw a face pass's mouth (its venv, its weights; `full` only).
ExperimentalMouthModelCaps.title: ExperimentalMouthModelCaps

ExtendFrom.description:
D88 XE (experimental): continue a clip — its last `lead` frames lead the new one in (LTX: 9 pinned by LTXVAddGuide at frame 0;
Wan: 1, the start image is its last frame). The new clip records `chained_from` / `overlap`.
ExtendFrom.title: ExtendFrom

ExtendQueued.description: D88 XE (experimental): the continuation's job, its start (the clip's last frame, extracted) and the lead-in it pins.
ExtendQueued.title: ExtendQueued

FinalLine.description: D118 (AE4b): a voiced line of the shot's Dialogue nodes, with the final's layer its speaker's character performs (None: none).
FinalLine.title: FinalLine

FlowGraph.description: The thin index (loom R139): where the nodes sit, the edges, the start — rebuilt from the node files when missing or disagreeing.
FlowGraph.title: FlowGraph

FlowLine.description: One line of a Dialogue node: the speaker is a profile (its mention), the text the line (loom R152: the subtitles come from these).
FlowLine.title: FlowLine

FlowNode.description:
One node of the flow, one file (loom R139). The fields a type uses: Dialogue `lines` (+ a bound shot), Shot a bound shot, Choice
`options`, Condition `cond`, Action `set`, Jump `target`, Comment `text`; Start and Hub carry a title. `shot_id` / `shot_version`
are set by binding only (loom R146: sole ownership).
FlowNode.title: FlowNode

FlowOption.description: A Choice's option: its own out-port (`opt:<id>`), an optional requirement on a variable, the variables it sets (loom R135).
FlowOption.title: FlowOption

GroupUser.description:
One record that names a group. `id` opens the user (a profile, style, node, stage or library entry); `name` is its name; `extra` the
detail the line shows (a version's label, a node's type, an entry's field); `version` the profile version; `group_id` the group it names
(the asked group, or one inside it when `deep`).
GroupUser.title: GroupUser

Guide.description:
P13 ST4 (D76, 16 §8): a pass sequence (a video asset the Stage rendered — depth by default, pose as the weaker second) that LTX-2.3's
IC-LoRA Union conditions the whole clip on, from frame 0. The start frame is a Stage shot; the clip keeps lineage to both.
Guide.title: Guide

GuideUpload.description:
ST4 (16 §8): a pass rendered per frame of the range — each frame a PNG put through `PUT /blobs/{sha}`, in order — with the
per-frame COCO-18 keypoints (for the rig's scoring).
GuideUpload.title: GuideUpload

I2I.description:
Refine (10 §4): partial-denoise img2img over the visible composite, the active layer or the selection crop.
Distilled Klein cannot partial-denoise (04 §4), so the model is Klein base or dev.

model_id.description: roster id; default: the registry's i2i model (D65)
model_id.title: Model Id

I2I.title: I2I

I2V.description:
Image-to-video (11 §10; D8 Wan 2.2 I2V-A14B fp8 experts + Lightning, FLF on the same weights; D9 LTX-2.3 distilled
fp8 with keyframe beats). Sizes and frame counts snap to the model's rule in the compiler (Wan ×16 and 4n+1,
LTX ×32 and 8n+1); `graphs.i2v_params` shows the UI what will run.

model_id.description: roster id; default: the registry's i2v model (D65)
model_id.title: Model Id

I2V.title: I2V

I2VPreview.description: `POST /recipes/preview` for an i2v recipe: snapped size and frames, the preset that runs, missing weights, ETA.
I2VPreview.title: I2VPreview

ImageSetBody.description: SC3 (D120): a set from a Catalogue image — MoGe's relief of the picture, the picture's camera beside it.

lens_deg.description: the picture's horizontal field of view in degrees when known; None = MoGe's own reading
lens_deg.title: Lens Deg

relief.description: cut at depth jumps or one sheet; None = cut, or the rebuilt set's own
relief.title: Relief

replace_set_id.description: SC3b: rebuild this picture set in place (a corrected lens) instead of adding one
replace_set_id.title: Replace Set Id

ImageSetBody.title: ImageSetBody

Inpaint.description:
Inpaint / outpaint (10 §4, D7): Fill (Klein + LanPaint), Fill-Match (Klein ICM), Fill Hero (dev + LanPaint),
Remove (Klein ICM with the hole neutralised), Outpaint (LanPaint on an edge-padded canvas). The region comes
from the document's selection (uploaded by the editor) unless the mode is outpaint.

model_id.description: roster id; default: the registry's inpaint model (D65)
model_id.title: Model Id

Inpaint.title: Inpaint

LibraryChange.description: D92: an entry added or edited — the library at its new revision and the entry.
LibraryChange.title: LibraryChange

LibraryRemoved.description: D92: an entry removed — the library at its new revision, the entry and where it stood (the Undo puts it back there).
LibraryRemoved.title: LibraryRemoved

LightSpec.description:
D110 (PS4): a light of the 3D scene — a sun from the object's position towards `target`, its strength, colour, the softness of its
shadow's edge and whether it casts one (the first three that do). A light object without one shines as E23c's key did (2.3, white,
hard shadows, aimed a metre above the origin), so earlier stages keep their look.
LightSpec.title: LightSpec

prompt_text.default: the character speaks the line to the camera, calm, natural head motion, steady camera, soft light
prompt_text.title: Prompt Text

LipsyncQueued.description: D88 XL (experimental): the talking clip's job — it lands as a take on the shot version.
LipsyncQueued.title: LipsyncQueued

LipsyncSettings.description:
D118 (AE4d, from E29b): the lip-sync model as a tool — LatentSync 1.5 in its own venv `tools/lipsync/.venv` with the checkout
`tools/lipsync/LatentSync` (scripts/lipsync-setup.ps1, tools/lipsync/AGENTS.md); never the engine's. The weights are OpenRAIL++: `full` only.
LipsyncSettings.title: LipsyncSettings

LoraCheckQueued.description: LT3 (18 §3h): the identity check's jobs — with and without the LoRA, the same seeds and sentences.
LoraCheckQueued.title: LoraCheckQueued

LoraOption.description: LT1 (18 §3e): one entry of the slots' picker — what the worker would load, and why it would not.
LoraOption.title: LoraOption

LoraRecordOut.description: LT2 (18 §3a): a trained LoRA of the project.
LoraRecordOut.title: LoraRecordOut

MaskFromContent.description: D116: a mask traced from the layer's visible content at `t`; with `follow`, keyed on every frame of the shot.
MaskFromContent.title: MaskFromContent

Mention.description:
D73: an @mention of an album group. The client sends the id (and the name it shows); the server resolves it into references and
stamps the group's revision and the asset ids it gave — a stamped mention is not resolved again. D85: a Story profile mention names
the profile (and a version, or its current one); the server swaps the version's reference group in and stamps both — the
`asset@version` pin of loom R98.
Mention.title: Mention

MeshCaps.description: P18 (D84): the image → mesh model of this build, or why there is none.
MeshCaps.title: MeshCaps

MotionSettings.description:
CA1 (proto01_animate 02 §5): the motion library's folders. The starter set (CC0, ships with loom2) defaults to <models_root>/motion;
the local folder holds the author's own downloads (e.g. Mixamo FBX) — never bundled, never in CI or tests.
MotionSettings.title: MotionSettings

NodeShot.description: A bind / unbind / spawn: the node and the shot it now owns (or released).
NodeShot.title: NodeShot

PassBody.description:
D118 (AE4a): a pass on the layer — the preset and its strength; a seed given is a re-run with another. AE4c: `face` and `lipsync`
(the strength unused).
PassBody.title: PassBody

PassesUpload.description:
ST3 (16 §7): the passes the client rendered for one camera — each a PNG already put through `PUT /blobs/{sha}` — with the COCO-18
keypoints behind the pose pass and the mask pass's colour legend.
PassesUpload.title: PassesUpload

PoseCellCaps.description: D115: one coverage cell — a shot size, an angle, an expression (the Poses section's tiles and chips).
PoseCellCaps.title: PoseCellCaps

PoseLibrary.description: ST2: the project's saved poses — name → {preset?, joints {joint: [x, y, z] degrees}} — kept as `stages/poses.json`.
PoseLibrary.title: PoseLibrary

PresetIconPlanned.description: D90 (02 §6.3): one swatch a make queued — the key its file will have and the job that makes it.
PresetIconPlanned.title: PresetIconPlanned

ProcessingLayer.description:
D118 (AE4e): a pass over the flattened stack from a layer down — the composition rendered with only that layer and the ones below
it, the pass's frames frozen as footage the composition shows right above that layer (`processing/<id>/frames/`). The composition
says it is stale when the layers below changed since (their signature).
ProcessingLayer.title: ProcessingLayer

ProfileAdded.description:
D93 (A2): assets added to a profile version — as the hero, into the reference set or as candidates. An asset from Unprocessed or
the version's own candidates page moves; one from any other page is copied (`copied`: original → copy) and the original stays.
ProfileAdded.title: ProfileAdded

ProfileVersion.description:
One version of a profile (loom §3.4): its reference set is an album group (`group_id`), its expansion candidates another; `open`
is editable and expandable, `final` locks the group and the fields (a retake is a new version). `trigger` and `lora` wait for the
LoRA wave (D25). D93 (B4): the version holds a character sheet — appearance (the look), outfit, bound colours and marks — composed into
the clause a mention and a linked subject carry (`compose_sheet`); a version is a costume, an age or a look, named by its `label`.
Schema 1 had one free-text `stub`: it is read as the appearance (the file is rewritten at the next save).
ProfileVersion.title: ProfileVersion

ProjectFormat.description: The target the project finalises to (fixed at creation) and the working tier it defaults to (D18).
ProjectFormat.title: ProjectFormat

ReangleMethodCaps.description: P14 (D82): one angles method — the model it runs, its health, measured seconds and the moves it is good for.
ReangleMethodCaps.title: ReangleMethodCaps

RecipeRun.description: One job's contribution to a step: what it ran with, what it read (stamps) and what it made.
RecipeRun.title: RecipeRun

RefineEdge.description: D45 Refine Edge (Photoshop's Select and Mask units). Defaults = matting.DEFAULTS, published in /capabilities.refine_edge (T8).
RefineEdge.title: RefineEdge

RefineEdgeCaps.description: D45: Refine Edge defaults (what the worker runs when a field is left out) and slider ranges [min, max, step].
RefineEdgeCaps.title: RefineEdgeCaps

RefineReply.description: D45: the refined selection is stored on the document; fetch it with GET /documents/{id}/selection.
RefineReply.title: RefineReply

SampleModelCaps.description: D91: a model Settings › Samples may pick for the style samples and the preset swatches (the default first).
SampleModelCaps.title: SampleModelCaps

SamplePx.description: D91: the square sizes a sample model renders at — the style sample and a preset swatch (a size the model handles well).
SamplePx.title: SamplePx

SampleSettings.description:
D90: the prompt a style's sample is rendered with (the style's fragment is appended by the server), and the scene each look
preset's swatch is rendered on. Editable in Settings › Samples; a blank entry is its default again, a scene without `{value}` gets it
appended. Changing them does not remake existing samples.

style_prompt.default: a woman in a long coat beside an old bicycle on a cobbled street at dusk, a lit shop window behind her
style_prompt.title: Style Prompt

SampleSettings.title: SampleSettings

Segment.description:
AI Select (10 §4, D7 masks): a mask from the visible composite becomes (part of) the document's selection.
`subject` = BiRefNet matte through the core background-removal nodes; `text` / `points` / `box` = SAM 3
(core `SAM3_Detect` on the sam3.pt checkpoint). Coordinates are document pixels; the queue scales them.

model_id.description: roster id; default: the registry's segment model (D65)
model_id.title: Model Id

Segment.title: Segment

SessionInfo.description: D67: the per-launch read-only media key (`?k=` on media URLs) and the session id.
SessionInfo.title: SessionInfo

SheetColour-Input.description:
D93 (B4): a colour bound to what it colours ("#C0392B" + "rain jacket") — the way Generate's Tree prompt binds colours (a hex code
in front of its object); one without an object is kept on the sheet but not sent (a palette alone is weak).
SheetColour-Input.title: SheetColour

SheetColour-Output.description:
D93 (B4): a colour bound to what it colours ("#C0392B" + "rain jacket") — the way Generate's Tree prompt binds colours (a hex code
in front of its object); one without an object is kept on the sheet but not sent (a palette alone is weak).
SheetColour-Output.title: SheetColour

ShotTake.description: Something tried for a shot version: an image (a stage-shot result, a Catalogue image) or a clip; the version picks one of each.
ShotTake.title: ShotTake

ShotVersion.description:
One version of a shot (loom R62): where it is made (a stage camera, or nothing — a clip from Animate), the frame and the one clip it
owns, every take tried; `final` fixes the clip the Flow and the Episode bind (one per version, loom R166). `stage_revision` is the
stage's revision when the frame or clip was taken — a later edit of the stage makes the version stale (advisory).
ShotVersion.title: ShotVersion

StageAnimateCaps.description: CN4: Wan2.2 Animate on the pose pass — one window (`frames_max`), one figure per pass (`figures_max`).
StageAnimateCaps.title: StageAnimateCaps

StageClipCaps.description: P13 ST4 (D76): the video model that animates a stage through its IC-LoRA — health, E11's seconds, the guide kinds, its grid.
StageClipCaps.title: StageClipCaps

StageMethodCaps.description: P13 ST3 (D78): one Stage → image method — the model it runs, its health, E10's seconds, the pass it takes and the references it allows.
StageMethodCaps.title: StageMethodCaps

StoryBeat.description: One line of the spine (loom L1 "story spine"): a Flow node is made from it by hand, never synced (loom R55).
StoryBeat.title: StoryBeat

StoryCaps.description: 17 §3b (D85): the model Expand runs on in this build, its health and warm seconds, the presets with their cell counts, the coverage vocabulary.
StoryCaps.title: StoryCaps

StoryChanged.description: 17 (D85): a Story record moved on the server (`kind`: world; later profile, shot, node) — open tabs reload it.
StoryChanged.title: StoryChanged

StoryStyle.description: One style of the world: the fragment a generation appends (17 §3a); `group_id` is a reference album (a later slice).
StoryStyle.title: StoryStyle

StoryVariable.description: A Flow variable (loom R135: bool or enum flags, nothing more in v1); conditions and actions read them by name.
StoryVariable.title: StoryVariable

SubjectShot.description:
D93 (B4): a linked subject's words for this shot only — an outfit in place of the sheet's, and a line after the sheet ("soaked, hood
up"). The character's sheet itself is read from Cast at submit (story.compose_subject), never copied into the panel.
SubjectShot.title: SubjectShot

model_id.description: roster id; default: the registry's t2i model (D65)
model_id.title: Model Id

T2IPreview.description: `POST /recipes/preview` for a t2i recipe: the effective parameters, the exact serialised prompt, missing weights, ETA.
T2IPreview.title: T2IPreview

TimelineExported.description:
P17: an export written from the sequence document — the file inside the project and its text; `audio` (CN2) the spoken lines the
FCPXML / EDL carry on their audio lane.
TimelineExported.title: TimelineExported

ToolCaps.description: D65: an Edit tool (an upscaler, an AI Select model) from the registry.
ToolCaps.title: ToolCaps

Train.description:
LT2 (18 §2 / §3c): how ai-toolkit trains a LoRA on this base — its arch name, the encoder's hub folder, offloading (the 9B base's
only fit on 16 GB, E16d) and E16's measured peak and rate on this card.
Train.title: Train

TrainCaps.description: LT2 (18 §4): whether the trainer can run, the bases and E16's figures, the ranges the Cast dialog offers.
TrainCaps.title: TrainCaps

TrainerSettings.description: LT2 (18 §3c): ai-toolkit in its own venv — never the engine's (scripts/trainer-setup.ps1).
TrainerSettings.title: TrainerSettings

TtsQueued.description: CN2: the voice jobs of a line or of a node's lines — one job per voice.
TtsQueued.title: TtsQueued

Upscale.description:
Upscale (10 §4): ESRGAN-class model on the visible composite or the active layer → a Catalogue asset at the
new size (lineage to the document's source) and, optionally, a 1× "detail" layer in the document. With `refine`
the upscaled image is re-sampled tile by tile at low strength (Klein base / dev; Ultimate-SD-Upscale pattern).

model_id.description: roster id; default: the registry's upscale model (D65)
model_id.title: Model Id

refine_model_id.description: roster id; default: the registry's i2i model (D65)
refine_model_id.title: Refine Model Id

Upscale.title: Upscale

VoiceCaps.description:
CN2 (19 §3b): whether the TTS runner can run, the tiers with E20's figures (and whether their models are cached), the draft voices,
the languages, the pace range.
VoiceCaps.title: VoiceCaps

VoiceRecordOut.description:
CN2 (19 §3b): a voice of the project (story/voices/): the draft tier's fixed Kokoro voice, or the cloning tier's reference clip with
its transcript and the consent note.
VoiceRecordOut.title: VoiceRecordOut

VoicesSettings.description: CN2 (19 §3b): the TTS tiers in their own venv `voices/.venv` — never the engine's (scripts/voices-setup.ps1, voices/AGENTS.md).
VoicesSettings.title: VoicesSettings

VramPressure.description: D69: a GPU job was admitted while the engine had less free VRAM than its reserve + 1 GB — the UI releases hidden GPU stages.
VramPressure.title: VramPressure

schema.title: Response Assets Counts Assets Counts Get
Response Assets Groups Assets Groups Get

put.description:
P18 (D84): a view rendered by the client becomes the asset's thumbnails — the Stage renders a mesh with a camera fitted to its bounding
sphere, which the engine's RenderMesh (its camera inside some props) cannot. A PNG body, ≤ 8 MB; the record notes `thumb_source: client`.

post.description:
D88 XE (experimental): continue the clip on its own model, preset, size, fps and length — its last frame extracted as the start
(`frame-extract` lineage), its last `extend_lead` frames pinned as the lead-in (LTX 9; Wan 1 = the start alone). 422 with the sentence.
Master frames → Catalogue images with `frame-extract` lineage from the clip's asset (11 §6).

get.description: A master frame as PNG; with `size` a cached WebP thumbnail (longer side ≤ size) for the filmstrip (C24).

post.description: FaceSim advisory on demand (11 §6): cosine similarity of the start frame's face across the clip.

put.description:
Replace the stack. The reply lists raster layers / masks the server has no bytes for, so the editor uploads
them before `/save` even when it does not consider them dirty (B15: delete · save · undo · save).

post.description:
Queue an inpaint / refine / upscale job on this document (10 §13); results come back as layers
(`document.changed` events with `added`) or, for upscale, as a Catalogue asset too.

Raw straight-alpha RGBA of the editor's GPU composite (w·h·4 bytes) → per-channel delta against the exact
flatten (10 §14 item 1). Both images are kept under temp/compare for inspection; the result lands in doc.meta.

schema.title: Response Documents Flatten Documents  Doc Id  Flatten Post

put.description: Raw uint8 body: RGBA (w·h·4 bytes) for images, grey (w·h) for masks; the fast path from the compositor (E2).

get.description: The document's selection as raw grey bytes (the AI Select result lands here, M5 slice 2).

put.description: The editor's selection as raw grey bytes (w·h); an empty body clears it. The M5 edit jobs read it.

post.description:
D45 Refine Edge: refine the document's selection against its exact composite (guided filter in the edge band, then smooth /
feather / contrast / shift edge); the result replaces the selection. Upload the editor's selection first (PUT …/selection).
PS5a: a final from the scene's layers — the record and each layer's passes (Stage's renders at the shot's rate) on disk.

PS5e: composite the final's layers into the shot (a CPU job): the plate under Stage's shadows, the props and the characters in
depth order, each character on her shadow (D107); a clip, and a take on the Story shot it was made for.

The final's composition written from its layers and the assembly's result through the EffectCraft session — made, or made again
from the layers (the edits dropped).
D118 (AE4b): a line attached as an audio layer of the composition at `t`, bound to the character's layer.

delete.description: D118 (AE4b): the audio layer taken out of the composition.

post.description: Several engine commands as one edit (one save, one revision; the first refusal stops it, 422 with the engine's message).
One engine command on the composition, saved; the engine's refusal comes back as 422 with its message.

get.description:
AE3: the engine's definitions of the effects named (comma-separated): id, category, GPU, the parameters with their types, defaults,
ranges and options — the Effects section's tiles and dials come from here (T8).

A frame of the composition at `t` seconds as PNG, its longest side `side` (0: full size) — the viewer's preview (AP1 thin);
`before` (AE3): the same frame with every effect off, nothing saved.
The composition's layers, top to bottom, as the engine reports them.

One layer (its id or name): the header and the flat property list (path, type, value, keys) — or, with `tree`, the property tree
(groups with their uids: the masks with their mode and inverted, AE2c).

schema.title: Response Composition Layer Finals  Fid  Composition Layers  Lid  Get

post.description:
D116: a new mask on the layer traced from what is visible on it — a character's matte, a prop's alpha, the shadows — at the frame
under `t`; with `follow` (the default) the path is keyed on every frame of the shot so the mask follows. The result says the mask's
uid, its points and the frames keyed. 422 when the layer has nothing to trace (the plate; an empty frame).

get.description: One property of a layer: its value at `t`, whether it is animated, its keyframes.

schema.title: Response Composition Property Get Finals  Fid  Composition Layers  Lid  Property Get

post.description: A layer's property set (or keyed at `time`), saved.

The finished shot: the composition rendered by `effectcraft-cli render` as a CPU job — a clip that becomes the final's clip and a
take on its Story shot.

D118: every layer whose source moved on the final (a pass landed) swapped in the composition — the Final level calls it when a
pass's job lands.

put.description: A layer's own sequence made by the client (PS5b: the projected plate) — stored as its `frames/`; the layer is done.

post.description: PS5d: matte a performed character layer again (SAM 3 by text on its frames) — it runs by itself after the layer's last batch.

D118 (AE4a): a pass on the layer's frames — Clean up (Wan 2.2's low-noise expert at a low strength) or Creative (LTX-2.3 locked to
the layer's depth) — as a GPU job; its result becomes a take the layer shows. A character layer or the plate (a prop's RGBA comes later).
AE4c: Face and Lip-sync on a character layer with keypoints and a matte — a chain of jobs (the talking head per line window for
Lip-sync, then Wan Animate on the head crop in batches), the last of which pastes the heads back and records the take.

PS5c: perform a character layer — its figure's character (the bound Cast version's animation reference) placed where the figure

it under the camera's passes entry (`guides[kind]`) and comes back at its new revision.

floor and the picture's camera (active) — `stage.updated` says so. 422 when the asset is not a Catalogue image.

Each pass becomes an asset (`lineage_kind = stage-pass`, suite stage, `params {stage_id, camera_id, revision, pass, size}`, the
keypoints on the pose pass, the legend on the mask pass) placed on the stage's album page (made on first use, D34); the document
records them for the camera and comes back at its new revision.

Every non-empty line of the node, grouped by voice (each speaker's own; the body's as the fallback) — one job per voice.
